# Telegram bots

WhatsApp resend (14 October 2026): every message Laravel sends on WhatsApp (Web and Cloud clients, `DeliverClientDocument` included) is kept in `whatsapp_outbox_messages` by `WhatsAppOutbox::record` (recipient digits, kind text/choice/document/image, text or caption, buttons, a copy of the file under `storage/app/private/whatsapp-outbox`, last 10 per chat, older rows and files pruned). A client sentence like «ارجع آخر 3 رسائل», «عيد آخر رسالة» or «resend the last 2 messages» (`WhatsAppOutbox::requestedCount`, Arabic digits and words, «رسائل» alone means 3) is caught in `HandleWhatsAppInbound` before complaints and every flow (`resendLastMessages`): a short line, then those messages oldest first, at most 3 (asking for more says the limit). Resends are not recorded again. No history answers «ما في رسائل سابقة أعيد إرسالها». Telegram is not covered.

Staff payment reply (14 October 2026): `payok:` in `bot/staff.py` adds the invoice line from `/bot/staff/confirm-payment` (`invoice_summary`, e.g. «🧾 الفاتورة INV/2026/0090 مرحّلة ومدفوعة.»); when Odoo did not take it (`invoice_error`) the line starts with ⚠️ and gives the reason.

WhatsApp detail changes in a sentence (14 October 2026): `routeSentence` first runs `applyProfileSentence`. `profileEditFromText` reads an email, a phone (a phone word plus digits, Arabic digits too), or «اسم الشركة / اسمي … صار|الى|ل|: value»; when the rules miss but the text names a detail and a change verb, `GeminiService::parseProfileEdit` returns `{field, value}`. A value is saved through `saveProfileEdit` (Odoo updated); a field without a value opens that field. This runs before the «تعديل» request-edit intent, so «تعديل الرقم الى …» no longer opens request editing. A number without a country code only asks the country (`askPhoneCountry`: the number, plus buttons `pcc:963|961|966|971|90`); a name, a code, or a sentence («من سوريا», «سوري», «+961») is joined to it (`ClientPhone::dialFor`). New WhatsApp chats keep the phone only when the sender digits are a real number (`ClientPhone::fromCallerDigits`); a WhatsApp internal id (LID) is not saved, the card shows «غير مضاف», and `gateProfile` asks for the number.

Client profile and request edits (14 October 2026): the Telegram client bot has «👤 بياناتي» (name, phone, company, email; inline `pedit:` buttons, saved through `/bot/telegram/profile`, which updates the Odoo partner). WhatsApp «بياناتي» adds «إضافة إيميل» / «تعديل الإيميل» (`prof:email`), and every profile edit there overwrites the Odoo partner and lead. Editing a request's title or description from either bot goes through `ApplyClientRequestEdit`: Odoo lead note plus the ClickUp sales task renamed.

Complaint tickets (12 October 2026): a staff reply reaches the client on the complaint's WhatsApp or Telegram chat with a «رد على التذكرة» button (`tkt:{id}`). WhatsApp handles the button in `HandleWhatsAppInbound`; the Telegram client bot forwards it to `/bot/telegram/complaint`. After a staff reply on the bot the chat watches that ticket for 24 hours: the client's next text or voice note (transcribed) is filed on it without pressing anything, and each answer keeps the watch two more hours. A menu button, «إلغاء», or «شكوى» (a new complaint) ends it; the button reopens it later. Complaints and ticket answers on WhatsApp pass at any hour; the rest of the chat keeps the WhatsApp window. Email answers: `ops:complaint-email-replies` reads the reports@ inbox over IMAP every two minutes (webklex/php-imap, no ext-imap) and files unread mail whose subject names a ticket and whose sender is the client's email, quoted text cut.

Mobile app sign-in codes arrive as a plain bot message: clients get them from the client bot (or WhatsApp for `wa:` chats), employees from the staff bot. The message names the app, the 6-digit code, the 5-minute lifetime, and asks not to share it. It is sent even while the dashboard pauses the client channel. A number that never started a bot chat gets nothing; the app points the person to the client bot. See `api.md` › Mobile app.

A client the team added (dashboard or Odoo, no chat yet) who writes on WhatsApp from the phone on their record is that client: the chat links to them instead of making a second client. A quotation sent from the dashboard on WhatsApp leaves the chat waiting for «1» / «موافقة» (approve) or «2» (reject, then the reason); those answers pass outside WhatsApp hours. A message that is only «.» or «نقطة» returns the welcome. The client can cancel a request until 24 hours after the invoice was sent and before anything is paid; after that the bot refuses. Telegram and WhatsApp share `CancelClientRequest`: the cancel also cancels the unpaid Odoo invoice or the unconfirmed quotation, and a confirmed sales order is left to sales with a note. A photography booking is still cancelled by the team.

The client bot has a «شكوى» button on WhatsApp and Telegram. The client sends a title, a description or a voice note, then an optional photo. Video is refused. Laravel stores the row and notifies Sales. `POST /api/bot/telegram/complaint` runs the same conversation as WhatsApp.

A photography refusal is plain text, so the next digit is not the main menu. Day and time lists are buttons only; WhatsApp numbers them once. More than ten times adds «أوقات كمان». «لغي موعد التصوير» notifies Media and does not refund. If the photography API fails on a photography sentence, the client bot says so and does not pass the sentence to the assistant. A reply typed on the company WhatsApp pauses that chat for two hours; «رجوع للبوت» resumes it. Offers go to the chat that last spoke (`hoc:client-reply`). A company reply of «شركة كذا» stores the name after that word. A long sentence is read by Gemini. A vague reply is asked again. Assistant replies are checked before they are sent: another client's phone, email, or request number is dropped, and the team gets the message instead. Receipts must be a real jpeg, png, webp, or pdf. Each chat is limited to 60 Telegram calls and 30 WhatsApp messages a minute. In production the example webhook secret is rejected.

The client Telegram bot has a «حجز تصوير» button and posts every sentence to `POST /api/bot/telegram/photography` before the assistant. Laravel runs the same photography conversation as WhatsApp and sends the reply on the client's Telegram chat. A sentence that is not about a shoot returns `handled: false` and the assistant answers it. `photoyes` / `photonno` and the day, time, and request buttons call the same endpoint.

WhatsApp client bot replies during the hours saved on the channels page (default 21:00–09:00 Asia/Damascus, crossing midnight). Team hours are separate (default 09:00–21:00) and are used for photography slots. The bot never tells the client that these clocks differ, and a closed reply does not state either clock. Client Arabic is Damascene and does not say it is a bot. When asked its name, it answers عمار. If a reply was not clear, it asks «شو الشي اللي مو واضح؟» and then explains the part the client names. The menu includes photography booking (day, then time, earliest slot is the channels-page lead in days, default 7, Friday skipped, shoots 5 hours apart, package allowance) and subscription renewal.

Path: `backend/bot/`  
Python 3, `python-telegram-bot==21.6`, httpx, dotenv. Shared runner: `telegram_http.py` (polling default, webhook if `TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL`). Every bot registers an error handler there: Telegram `NetworkError` / `TimedOut` (Bad Gateway on `getUpdates`) is ignored; any other error is sent to Sentry.

| File | Role | Webhook port |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main.py` | Client bot | 8445 (`client-bot`) |
| `staff.py` | Staff bot | 8444 (`staff-bot`) |
| `admin.py` | Admin ClickUp bot | 8446 (`admin-bot`) |
| `dev.py` | Developer alerts (`/ping`, `/status`, `/bots`, `/queue`, `/digest`). Allowlist `TELEGRAM_DEV_IDS` only. Heartbeats are files under `storage/app/dev-beats` every 3 minutes. `ops:watch-signals` every 15 minutes alerts once. `ops:dev-digest` at 09:00 Damascus. The dev process watches the scheduler file and alerts if it is older than 150 seconds. | 8447 (`dev-bot`) |

```powershell
cd backend\bot
python main.py  
python staff.py
python admin.py
```

Loads parent `.env` + local. API base `HOC_API_URL`. Secrets: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` / `TELEGRAM_BOT_SECRET`, staff equivalents, `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_BOT_TOKEN` / `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_BOT_SECRET`, allowlist `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`. Developer bot: `TELEGRAM_DEV_BOT_TOKEN` / `TELEGRAM_DEV_BOT_SECRET`, allowlist `TELEGRAM_DEV_IDS`, outbound chat `TELEGRAM_DEV_CHAT_ID`. Optional `TELEGRAM_PROXY`. `SENTRY_DSN` enables Python Sentry; empty disables it.

HTTP: client → `/api/bot/telegram/*`, staff → `/api/bot/staff/*`, admin → `/api/bot/admin/*`, header `X-Webhook-Secret`. WhatsApp Web (client bot) is the live transport when `WHATSAPP_TRANSPORT=web` and `WHATSAPP_WEB_URL` is set: the Node bridge `bot/whatsapp-web` (Baileys) posts inbound messages to `POST /api/bot/whatsapp/web` and Laravel sends replies to that bridge. The dashboard **قنوات البوت** shows the client QR until the company phone scans it, and a second QR for the admin phone (`/admin/status` on the same bridge, auth dir `whatsapp-web-admin`). Admin inbound is not the client bot. `POST /logout` on the bridge drops that session so another phone can scan. The bridge must be restarted after this file changes. Meta Cloud API (`GET|POST /api/bot/whatsapp/webhook`) stays closed unless `WHATSAPP_ENABLED=true`. The dashboard switch pauses WhatsApp Web the same way as Telegram. Staff/admin bots are not gated.

Reply Keyboard flows stay; Inline buttons expand them (catalog, quotation reject reasons, renewal).

**Drafts survive restarts.** `main.py` uses `LaravelPersistence` (PTB persistence, push every 3 s) → `GET /api/bot/telegram/drafts` at start, `PUT /api/bot/telegram/drafts/{telegram_id}` on change (outside the channel-pause gate, 64 KB cap, pruned after 14 days). Only the draft keys are stored: title, description, attachments, catalog stack, reject/revision/receipt target, profile step, edit target. Conversations `client_compose` and `client_edit` are persistent. Manual-request attachments are kept as Telegram `file_id` and downloaded only on «✅ تم الإرسال».

## Client bot

Renewal sends an invoice file and extends the period only after payment confirmation. «لن أجدد» keeps the current period and the client sees the end date only. Staff `planok` confirms the work plan after payment. A second revision returns `+963 968 862 822` / `info@hoc.agency`. The earliest photography slot is the lead saved on the channels page (default 3 days), not the next day. The client cannot open a photography slot, accept `photoyes` / `photonno`, or receive a day-before reminder or alarm link. The photography department stays a ClickUp task, and Friday is still skipped inside work scheduling. Two shoots on the same work day must start at least 5 hours apart. Approving one shoot at a taken time does not confirm it and does not add another calendar event; the client is offered a start 5 hours later. `ops:photography-separate-slots` keeps the earliest confirmed shoot in each window and deletes the extra Google Calendar events. Approving the first offers the second client that later time (`يناسبني` / `لا يناسبني`, callbacks `photoyes` / `photonno`). If the client refuses, the photographer sends another time (`phototime` then `POST .../propose`) until the client accepts. After confirmation the client gets one «تسجيل التذكير» link (`GET /photography-alarm/{booking}`, signed). The phone that opens it decides the action: Android places the clock alarm, iPhone receives the calendar file with a day-before alert. The message does not name the platform. `ops:photography-day-before` still sends a short chime one day ahead. Support shows the phone and the saved holidays. A manual description shorter than 15 characters asks for one clearer sentence before submit.

Telegram profile questions, one at a time: name, phone, company, then **email** (inline «لا يوجد بريد» or typed «لا يوجد» stores `email_skipped_at`) and **company activity** (≤ 60 chars). `missing_fields` from `/me` lists what is still unasked; existing clients get only the new questions on the next `/start` or «طلب جديد». Approve, receipt, revision, and file buttons never ask. Invalid answers return an Arabic 422 and the same question again. The Odoo partner and opportunity are created only after the last answer (`Client::readyForOdoo()` = `profileFinished()`); WhatsApp keeps the first three. `profile_complete` still means name+phone+company (dashboard visibility, request gate).

`/start` (Telegram) or the first WhatsApp message sends an Arabic welcome then collects missing profile fields. WhatsApp already supplies the phone (`wa_id`) so that step is usually skipped. While a phone is being typed, «خذ رقمي الحالي» stores that WhatsApp number. A number that already contains a country code is stored as `+` plus the digits. A local number asks which country, then the dial code is added. Keyboard buttons (طلب جديد / طلباتي / الدعم) are not saved as name, phone, or company. Link account; if name/phone/company missing, collect them then push `crm.lead` on sales team **تلغرام** and stage **تلغرام** immediately (HTTP returns after the Odoo create; the lead id is kept even if the follow-up snapshot is empty). Incomplete Telegram stubs are **not** pushed to Odoo and **not** listed on the staff dashboard until the profile is complete. `GET /me` is local profile only. `/start` uses the link payload and replies even if a later API call times out. Staff **soft-delete** hides the client from the dashboard and unlinks Odoo; the next `/me`, `/requests`, `/catalog`, or `/link` **restores the same row** (profile + طلباتي) without the client deleting the Telegram chat. A 404 (legacy hard delete) re-links in the same chat instead of showing «تعذر الاتصال بالخادم».  
New request: CMS catalog (categories → subcategories or packages → billing periods that exist, **no prices on buttons**, last option always **طلب يدوي**, **السابق** on every step including the first — first step returns to the main menu). `GET /catalog` restores a soft-deleted client and returns the page before any Odoo retry; a missing lead is pushed after the response. A catalog timeout tells the client to try again. Catalog callbacks replace the previous step. Choosing a package/period shows loading («جاري إنشاء طلبك وانتظار عرض السعر») then an Arabic confirmation. If `quotation_delivered` on WhatsApp, the quotation message is the only decision prompt (no second «تم إنشاء الطلب» and no second موافقة / رفض). Otherwise they are told to open طلباتي. Telegram still sends «سيصلك عرض السعر الآن». Sending the quotation PDF does **not** send «تمت الموافقة على عرض السعر». After the client taps موافقة, Laravel sends payment instructions / Sham Cash QR only (no extra approval line). Keyboard buttons cancel pending revision/reject and leave a manual-request or support conversation. Complete profile (name/phone/company) **pushes the CRM lead immediately**.  
طلباتي sends one card per request with Arabic `status_label`, package, paid/remaining, and buttons (10 at a time, then **عرض الأقدم**). Drive files are the client delivery: each file has one row **تعديل** + **موافقة**; **اعتماد التسليم** appears after every sent file is approved, or after the folder is idle ~2 minutes (or staff deliver). An open revision is not closed by that idle timer; the next Drive file returns the request to in progress. Support shows phone `0947823488` only, with no holiday list and no photography booking rules. A free question that describes a business and asks for a package is answered by Gemini with one published package and a button **أنشئ الطلب** that opens that package. A voice note is transcribed and then run as that sentence. «بدي جدد الاشتراك» renews when the subscription is inside its last 8 days, and «لن أجدد» declines it. «موعد تصوير» asks which subscription, checks that the chosen one is active and includes photography, then offers days. The client picks a paid package that includes photography, then a day and a time. The ClickUp photography task is created only after that time is agreed, for 3 hours. Design, content, and programming tasks are created from the package hour lines when the plan is confirmed. One shoot is used per 3 photography hours. A question about what is inside the client's request («شو بالطلب») asks which request, then shows that request's ClickUp task hours. «طلباتي» and «شو صار بطلب» still open the status list. The WhatsApp chat follows the latest message: Arabic letters keep Arabic, Latin letters switch to English, and digits keep the current language. Sentence routing and package answers stay on Gemini in that language. A client sentence is routed by meaning for every operation: orders, a new request, an inquiry, support, profile data, approving or rejecting a quotation, and the suggested package. The exact menu word is not required. While the bot is collecting a name, company, title, or description, that message is saved as the value. An open quotation stays on موافقة / رفض until payment receipt or a rejection reason; the main menu does not replace that choice. «الباقة أكبر» is not a rejection: it sends a new quotation for the next higher package in the same group, and a separate ad-budget line when that package has one. Other clients, invoices, staff, and internal costs stay closed. Greetings stay on the menu. **طلباتي** opens one numbered list; opening a request shows its status, payment, and the actions still allowed. Editing the title and description is allowed only while the request is `Submitted`. After execution starts, **طلب تعديل** is the delivery revision. A sentence that no fixed rule catches goes to the client assistant (`ClientAssistant`, Gemini). It reads this client's own requests (status, package, money, renewal date, photography sessions and bookings, delivered and approved files, work hours), the list of bot operations, and the published brief. It answers from those facts, or runs one operation (requests, open one request, new, photo, renew, decline renewal, hours, edit, profile, approve, reject, receipt, support). A greeting gets the menu without Gemini. When it cannot answer with certainty, or Gemini does not reply, the client is told the team has the message (with the support phone when Gemini is down) and the message, the last turns, and the client's records are emailed to developer@hoc.agency once. The Telegram client bot sends unrouted text to `POST /bot/telegram/assistant` and follows the same answer. Revision asks «ما هي التعديلات المطلوبة» as a normal chat line (no Telegram dialog). A file revision notifies sales/production with that image plus the client’s reason. Approving a file (or the whole delivery) notifies staff that the client accepted it. Staff/admin cannot mark a Drive request completed until every sent file is approved. Poll lists the **request folder** recursively, resolves Google shortcuts (Photos “add”), and never sends files sitting on the HOC Clients root or loose in the company/package folders. Replacing the same Drive file (new `modifiedTime`/hash) or uploading a new Drive id with the **same filename** updates that delivery and the client caption says it was modified; an unknown name is a new file. Revision taps (`revision:` / `revfile:`) are handled first: silent callback ack + a normal ForceReply chat message (no Telegram dialog). File approval (`okfile:`) posts `POST /bot/telegram/requests/{id}/approve-file`. Intent is kept even if the client is mid “طلب جديد”; the reason is not stolen as a new title, and API errors (e.g. no files yet) are shown in Arabic. Completed/cancelled folders are not polled. Support notifies sales. Photos become receipts only after **رفع وصل الدفع** or quotation approve, and the hint clears on nav. Catalog period taps are debounced (same package/period within 3 minutes returns the existing request). `ops:poll-drive` every minute over live folders (limit 200), or `ops:poll-drive --file={id}` / `--request={id}`. n8n Drive trigger only sees items sitting **directly** in HOC Clients (not nested request folders). Nested uploads go out immediately via Google `changes.watch` → `POST /api/integrations/drive/changed` (lists the changed file ids) or within a minute via `ops:poll-drive`. Dashboard **تحديث الإرسال** is a manual fallback. Default API `:8000`. The staff request page shows whether each Drive file reached the client bot. The **client bot must be running** for revision buttons; Drive send itself is Laravel → Telegram.  
Quotation: approve or reject first; after reject the client picks غالي / تأخير / سبب مكتوب. A rejection deletes the draft or cancels the sent quotation in Odoo; the next quotation (or «الباقة أكبر») is a new `sale.order`. Sales staff are notified with a private Telegram link (`tg://user?id=`) to the client who decided. Approving a quotation with a payable amount sends the **shared Sham Cash QR** plus 50%/full payment instructions with amounts in **USD**. If the quotation has no amount, the client gets an acknowledgment only (no QR and no payment instructions). That QR is not the client's proof-of-payment photo. The client then uploads their transfer proof. Sales receive the receipt (or the approval notice) with a **ClickUp work plan** (department, assignee, priority, hours) and an inline **تأكيد الدفع** button (`payok:{number}` → `POST /api/bot/staff/confirm-payment`). Staff can still confirm the received amount from the dashboard. The invoice PDF is sent after confirm. Package work plans are cached so a repeated catalog package assigns immediately without a second large AI review.

## Bot SLA (`ops:process-bot-sla`)

Laravel decides eligibility (every minute, Asia/Damascus, `ops_follow_ups` once-per-kind). Conversation stays in the Python bots — catalog, approve/reject, receipt upload, support chat, and reject reasons are **not** n8n canvases. n8n may retry a staff/client text via `POST /integrations/telegram/notify`, or kick Drive delivery via `POST /integrations/drive/poll` (published **HOC Drive to Client Bot**: OAuth **Google Drive account** watches **HOC Clients** for **folderCreated** only — fileCreated/fileUpdated are disabled so root drops are not sent; nested request-folder files go out via Laravel `changes.watch`; webhook `hoc-drive-file`; files and folders outside HOC Clients are ignored). Live n8n HTTP nodes do not read `$env` (Cloud blocks it) and call `https://api.hoc.agency` with `X-N8N-Secret`.

| Gap | After | Who | What |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Submitted, no quotation | 2h | Sales | Card: number, client, `tg://user?id=` |
| `awaiting_payment`, no receipt | 12h then 24h | Client then sales | Client: reminder + Sham Cash QR; sales escalate. Skipped when `isFullyPaid()` / no amount due |
| Receipt uploaded, still unpaid | 3h | Sales | Re-send payok card with expected USD. Skipped when the invoice is already fully paid |
| Payment confirmed | immediately | Client | «بدأ التنفيذ — القسم — المتوقع» (not cron) |
| `revision_requested` / support unanswered | 1h | Production + sales / sales | Staff card |
| Incomplete Telegram profile | 1 day | Client | One reminder (name/phone/company) |
| Morning digest | 09:00 Damascus | Sales | Counts: awaiting quote, awaiting receipt, receipts to review, open revisions |
| Quote / invoice / Drive Telegram send failed | on failure | Sales + admin ids | Once per artifact |

**WhatsApp client automation (Laravel, not n8n).** Tests: `tests/Feature/ClientAutomationTest.php`.
- `ops:photography-hours-before` runs every 5 minutes. Two hours before a confirmed shoot (`hour_reminded_at`, reset with `reminded_at` on confirm and move), it reminds the client on their chat and the photographer on WhatsApp. A shoot agreed inside those two hours is only marked. With no photographer assigned, the whole Media team is reminded.
- The day-before photographer reminder also goes over WhatsApp now. `NotifyEmployees::toEmployeeWhatsApp` sends to `ClientPhone::whatsappDigits($employee->phone)` from the company number, with a "do not reply" footer, and falls back to Telegram when there is no readable phone or WhatsApp is off.
- `ops:satisfaction-survey` runs every 15 minutes between 10:00 and 20:00 Damascus. It picks completions 2 hours to 3 days old (`request_status_history`), at most one per client every 7 days, and only clients whose chat is `wa:`. It writes `request_ratings` (unique per request) and sends 1 to 5 as a list `rate:{ratingId}:{n}`. A score of 3 or less asks `ratewhy:{id}:{time|quality|contact|price|other}` and alerts management. `HandleWhatsAppInbound::handleCallback` routes `rate*` first, and only the rating's own client can answer. There is no Google review link (not available in Syria) and no Telegram survey.
- `ops:finance-weekly` runs Sunday 09:00 Damascus and is skipped on staging. It covers Sunday to Saturday of the past week: invoiced compared with the week before, collected, expenses, net, open and overdue today, top 3 overdue partners, new and completed requests, and average rating. It is deduped by `OpsFollowUp::KIND_FINANCE_WEEKLY`.
- `NotifyEmployees::management()` sends to `WHATSAPP_MANAGEMENT_NUMBERS` (comma list); when it is empty or WhatsApp is off, it falls back to the `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` admin bot.

**WhatsApp support agent (n8n).** Tests: `tests/Feature/WhatsAppSupportAgentTest.php`. The n8n Cloud workflow "HOC WhatsApp Support Agent" (`vAOhhbcBuTrCumpC`, webhook `hoc-support-agent`) runs an AI Agent with Gemini on n8n gateway credits, window memory keyed by `session_id`, and a structured output `{reply, handoff, handoff_reason, action}` where `action` is `{type: none|create_request|cancel_request, title, description, request, reason}`.
- `WhatsAppSupportAgent` (Laravel) starts when the client asks for a person (`wantsHuman`), or after two assistant misses in a row (`session.assist_misses`, escalate or the unclear question), or after two unreadable replies at the phone step (`session.phone_misses`; a greeting does not count, the first miss explains and shows the stored number). A number typed while the agent has the chat still goes to the phone step (`answersPhoneStep`) and ends the agent. «خذ رقمي الحالي» is offered only when the chat carries a real number. It only runs when `N8N_SUPPORT_AGENT_URL` is set; otherwise the old escalation stays.
- While cache `hoc:wa-agent:{phone}` is active (30 minutes idle), free text goes to n8n with `X-N8N-Secret` (`N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, Header Auth credential "HOC Laravel Secret" in n8n). The body carries `session_id`, `locale`, `client_name`, `records` (`ClientAssistant::records`), `reason`, `support_phone`, and `message`. «رجوع للبوت» leaves the agent and shows the menu.
- On `handoff=true`, an n8n error, or an empty reply: the client is told a team member will answer, `NotifyEmployees::support()` alerts `WHATSAPP_SUPPORT_NUMBERS` (else management numbers, else the admin bot) with the last turns, and `holdForHuman` keeps the bot quiet for 2 hours. The agent hands off on discount or price negotiation, payment problems, refunds, complaints, dates, and promises.
- Secretary actions (`SupportAgentActions`, run after the agent reply): `create_request` opens a request through `SubmitServiceRequest` after the client confirms a summary (profile must be complete; `hoc:agent-create:{clientId}:{md5(title)}` dedupes 10 minutes) and sales send the quotation. `cancel_request` resolves the number with `ResolveServiceRequest::ownedBy`; a paid request goes to `NotifyEmployees::support()`, a closed one is refused, otherwise `ManagementCancelApproval::ask` sends a WhatsApp list to `WHATSAPP_MANAGEMENT_NUMBERS` (`cxok:{token}` / `cxno:{token}`, typed 1 or 2 also works; falls back to `NotifyEmployees::management()` when WhatsApp sends nothing). Keys: `hoc:cancel-approval:{token}` 7 days, `hoc:cancel-pending:{requestId}`. Approve runs `CancelClientRequest` and tells the client; refuse tells the client the request continues. After either answer the next management message (30 minutes, `hoc:cancel-note:{digits}`) is relayed to the client as a note. Management numbers are intercepted in `HandleWhatsAppInbound` before the client flow, so they must be personal numbers, not the company bot number. The bot's own «إلغاء» flow is unchanged (no approval). A first request for a person gets a greeting and "what is it about"; only a repeat request hands off. It answers honestly when asked whether it is a person. Gemini output limit 4096 (a lower limit returned empty answers), agent node retries 3 times.

Hours: `services.telegram.sla.*` / `BOT_SLA_*`. Remaining-balance cron (`ops:process-reminders`) also closes leftover reminders when the invoice is complete. Tests: `tests/Feature/BotSlaAutomationTest.php`.

## Staff bot

`/start` for an unknown chat asks for the employee code (`EMP-0001`). `POST /api/bot/staff/link` attaches that Telegram account to the employee already added from the dashboard or Odoo and keeps their status. `POST /api/bot/staff/join` still creates a pending row. Tasks, new requests (sales), reply templates, send quotation, deliver. `/start` shows «قسمك». **Quotation preview:** after amount and note the bot calls `POST /bot/staff/quotation/preview` (builds the Odoo order + PDF when Odoo answers; otherwise `CorrespondenceDocument` prints the same data on `correspondence.letter`. Nothing reaches the client) and shows the card + PDF with «✅ أرسل للزبون» (`qsend:{token}` → `quotation/confirm`, reuses the same Odoo order and PDF) or «✏️ تعديل المبلغ» (`qedit:{token}` → `quotation/discard`, back to amount). Tokens live 2 h in cache, so the buttons work after a bot restart. The old direct `POST /bot/staff/quotation` stays for compatibility. New codes take the next free `EMP-%04d` from the highest numeric suffix (not latest `id`), inside a DB transaction. Cards show number, client, company, package or manual, status, assignee. Sales: **قيد التجهيز** (`in_progress` from `payment_confirmed`), **إكمال الطلب**, and the **تأكيد الدفع** button on the payment-stage card. Production: in-progress + deliver. HTTP errors from join show an Arabic retry, not a raw traceback.

## Admin bot

Allowlisted Telegram IDs only (`TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`; `/api/bot/admin/me` is 403 otherwise, and the bot replies in Arabic with the sender's Telegram id to send to the developer). Adding an expense shows amount/category/note with «سجّل» / «إلغاء» before saving. This is the ops desk: **المهام** (open a ClickUp task → status / priority / due hours / assign), **إسناد ClickUp**, **العملاء** (review visible clients and their requests), **العمليات** (work-plan departments/assignees + rebuild), **المالية** (received invoice revenue, open remaining, `ops_expenses`, net; add expense by amount/category/note), **الملخص**, plus guest invite and department lists. Calendar due alerts: `ops:clickup-due-alerts`.

## Flowchart tests

`tests/Feature/BotFlowchartTest.php` covers the bot API contract: webhook secrets (401), client profile stairs (phone then company), catalog/manual/edit/cancel/support, quote reject → staff requote → pay → staff in-progress → deliver → revision → client complete, staff join pending until dashboard approve, admin allowlist + guest email + assign-in-department, staff delete then `/me`/`/link` restore with the same requests. Run with `php artisan test --filter=BotFlowchartTest`. It also covers the email/activity staircase and a bot-down flow finished from the dashboard (manual approve → pay → deliver → manual revision → manual complete). WhatsApp Cloud API verify/HMAC/link/menu (with `services.whatsapp.enabled` forced on): `tests/Feature/WhatsAppClientBotTest.php`. Dashboard pause and the WhatsApp lock: `tests/Feature/ClientChannelPauseTest.php`. Drafts and quotation preview: `BotDraftAndPreviewTest`. Manual client decisions and finance: `ClientFallbackTest`.

## Do not assume

Bots are not a shopper storefront. Website contact form does not call these endpoints. Live PDF Telegram check: `scripts/e2e-live-telegram.php` + `E2E_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` (optional, not CI). Missing Google keys do not abort a request. `TELEGRAM_STRICT=false` keeps catalog/pay local if Odoo/Telegram fail. WhatsApp Web uses `WHATSAPP_TRANSPORT=web` and `WHATSAPP_WEB_URL`. Meta Cloud API secrets stay unused unless `WHATSAPP_ENABLED=true`. Website `wa.me` contact links are not this bot.
